cover: Before you move clouds: a workload sorting sheet

slides.title: Group the invoice by what it pays for
slides.body: Look for download transfer fees, servers sized for a rare peak, and a load balancer, firewall, CDN and TLS billed separately.

slides.title: Mark each workload: moves as it is
slides.body: There's a natural home for it on the new platform, and it can go without changes.

slides.title: Mark it: needs a bridge
slides.body: It keeps running where it is while the rest moves around it.

slides.title: Mark it: stays
slides.body: GPU work, always-on services that hold their own data, and hard-won compliance setups are usually best left alone.

slides.title: For each move, write down three things
slides.body: The expected saving, the migration work, and what it would take to reverse it.

slides.title: Answer these before you commit
slides.body: Can traffic be split by route? What would the bill be with only the easy moves done? Who'll own the new setup?
